protocol.primary_selection_source: CICIDS2017 round1 validation; unchanged on external datasets
protocol.secondary_selection: external validation macro-F1, descriptive only; does not replace frozen primary
protocol.loaco: disabled unless --held-out-label is supplied; never reuse CICIDS2017 ID 26

input.completeness: Local inventory only; upstream release/completeness NOT verified

limitations: native schemas/class ontologies differ; scores not directly comparable tasks
random split may retain conflicting-label feature overlap; see preparation_report
native X+label dedup differs from CICIDS2017 full-row dedup
one seed, no proof of novelty, no independent temporal/group test
subprocess time is not inference latency; no standalone deployment entrypoint
